title: Sharḥ-i Ḥadīs-i ʿAmāʾ
transliterated_title: Sharḥ-i Ḥadīs-i ʿAmāʾ (Commentary on the Hadith of the Thin Cloud; variant Sharḥ-i Ḥadīs-i Ghamām)

date.basis: MS Majlis 10196 copy date, asterisked by Melvin-Koushki as possibly transcription; terminus ad quem only.

occasion: not stated (a commentary on the hadith answering where God was before creation)
manuscript: MS Majlis 10196/3 ff. 119b-20b; MS 10004 pp. 268-70; MS 3035/6; Princeton MS 2002/3.
majlis_folios: ff. 119b-20b (the folio range printed for Sharḥ Ḥaqīqat al-Waḥda, no. 36, is f. 120a-20b, so 120a-20b is claimed by both entries)
summary: A brief lettrist commentary on the hadith of the thin cloud, in answer to the question where God was before creation.
